name: openclimatedata/ndcs (GitHub)
license_or_terms: No repo LICENSE file (GitHub API: license null). README licenses the Python scripts as CC0-1.0; the data index itself carries no stated license. datapackage.json names the UNFCCC NDC Registry as source, no licenses field.
summary: Daily-updated CSV/JSON index of the UNFCCC NDC registry: party codes, titles, submission dates, document URLs. Factual registry metadata. We snapshot, hash and parse the index; its bytes are not redistributed because the data files are unlicensed.

name: openclimatedata/national-climate-plans (GitHub)
license_or_terms: ARCHIVED repo (README: no longer updated, superseded by openclimatedata/ndcs). No repo LICENSE file; README licenses scripts as CC0-1.0 only. The mirrored PDFs are government documents submitted to the UNFCCC; the repo states no license for them.
summary: PDF corpus mirror: one main NDC/INDC document per party under unified filenames. We use it as a byte source for document fetches (snapshot + hash + parse); PDF bytes stay in cache plus committed manifests and are not re-published in release assets. Archived status means it must never be treated as fresh.

name: JGuetschow/UNFCCC_non-AnnexI_data (GitHub)
license_or_terms: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE file present; verified via GitHub API license endpoint, spdx Apache-2.0).
summary: Code and processed datasets for non-AnnexI GHG submissions to the UNFCCC. Apache-2.0 permits use, modification and redistribution with attribution and the license text preserved. Underlying numbers are Party submissions. Redistributing repo-derived files in release assets is permitted with notice kept.

name: UN Treaty Collection (treaties.un.org)
license_or_terms: UN.org Terms of Use plus UN Copyright page; treaties.un.org's own Terms page only links to these. Terms: download/copy for personal non-commercial use; no resale, redistribution or derivative works without written permission; copyright page reserves all rights to the UN.
summary: We fetch the MTDSG status PDFs (.en.pdf), hash them and extract non-copyrightable facts (signature, ratification, accession dates). PDF bytes stay in cache plus committed manifests; they are not mirrored in release assets because the terms do not permit redistribution.

name: UNFCCC (unfccc.int)

Search-engine extracts describe personal non-commercial use with reproduction otherwise requiring written permission; COP-platform pages describe official texts as public domain with attribution, unverified for the main site.
summary: NDC and BTR files are Party submissions published for public access. Bytes are obtained via the proven public mirrors in this register, hashed and parsed. Because the terms could not be read live, document bytes stay in cache plus committed manifests and are not mirrored in release assets.

name: Bricolage Grotesque, Hanken Grotesk, IBM Plex Mono webfonts (house kit copy)
license_or_terms: SIL Open Font License 1.1. The OFL license texts are shipped verbatim alongside the font files in app/public/fonts/ (OFL.txt, OFL-IBM-Plex.txt, OFL-Bricolage-Grotesque.txt), copied with the woff2 files from the Visual Climate house kit.
summary: Webfonts served by the product screens (app/), and the only faces they load: Bricolage Grotesque (variable, 200-800) is the display voice, Hanken Grotesk carries the prose, the reading and the figures, and IBM Plex Mono carries only what is character-for-character (hashes, run ids, keys). This is the shipped Visual Climate product's own type system, ported with its stylesheet on 2026-10-17; nothing is fetched from a font host any more. OFL 1.1 permits use, bundling and redistribution provided the fonts are not sold by themselves and the license text stays with them — it does, in the same directory the pages load them from.

name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine (web.archive.org)
license_or_terms: Internet Archive Terms of Use (dated 31 Dec 2014). The live terms URL served only a JavaScript shell to our fetcher on 2026-10-15; the terms text was read from an existing Wayback capture of that same URL (timestamp 20241128004511). Terms: access to the Collections is granted for scholarship and research purposes; use must be noninfringing or fair use under copyright law; rights in archived content remain with its original publishers.
summary: Read-only access to EXISTING public captures: CDX index lookups plus id_ raw-byte replay of document URLs already archived. We never trigger Save Page Now or any live proxying of an origin site. The replayed bytes are UNFCCC Party submissions governed by the unfccc row: cache plus committed SHA-256 manifests only, no redistribution in release assets.

name: Natural Earth 1:110m admin-0 base map
license_or_terms: Public domain. Natural Earth's terms page dedicates all versions of Natural Earth vector and raster map data to the public domain; no permission needed for any use.
summary: Base-map shapes projected to Equal Earth and shipped as app/public/data/basemap.json (ported from the frozen predecessor with the attribution string embedded in the file). A base map, not a measurement: no figure on any screen is derived from it.

name: ashemag/human-atlas (GitHub)
license_or_terms: MIT (license text shipped verbatim beside the adapted module as app/src/lib/scene/HUMAN-ATLAS-LICENSE).
summary: Desk-spread packing layout adapted into app/src/lib/scene/explosion-layout.mjs for the 3D instrument's laid-flat chapter. MIT permits use, modification and redistribution with the copyright and permission notice preserved — it is, in the same directory the module lives in.

name: Archivo (Google Fonts) - NO LONGER LOADED
license_or_terms: SIL Open Font License 1.1. Archivo is published by Omnibus-Type under OFL 1.1 (the family page and the upstream repository both state OFL-1.1); Google Fonts serves it under that same license. The font files are NOT redistributed from this repository: the pages link the Google Fonts stylesheet, so the bytes are served by Google and the license travels with the upstream family.
summary: NO LONGER LOADED. Archivo was the display and text face of the product screens between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-17, while they carried the predecessor comps' dark instrument skin. The 2026-10-17 port of the shipped Visual Climate product's own stylesheet returned the screens to Bricolage Grotesque and Hanken Grotesk, both locally shipped (vc-kit-fonts), and removed the fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet link entirely. No screen requests Archivo; the row is kept so the register records what was once served rather than quietly dropping it.
